mapper.select: SELECT sa.*, c.coursename, ci.classname, s.studentname, s.studentno, t.teachername FROM student_attendance sa LEFT JOIN course c ON sa.courseid = c.courseid LEFT JOIN classinfo ci ON sa.classid = ci.classid LEFT JOIN student s ON sa.studentid = s.studentid LEFT JOIN teacher t ON sa.teacherid = t.teacherid WHERE sa.id = #{id}

SELECT * FROM student_attendance WHERE courseid = #{courseid} AND classid = #{classid} AND attenddate = #{attenddate}

SELECT sa.*, c.coursename, ci.classname FROM student_attendance sa LEFT JOIN course c ON sa.courseid = c.courseid LEFT JOIN classinfo ci ON sa.classid = ci.classid WHERE sa.studentid = #{studentid} AND sa.courseid = #{courseid} ORDER BY sa.attenddate DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_attendance (courseid, classid, studentid, attenddate, status, remark, createtime, teacherid, session_id) VALUES (#{courseid}, #{classid}, #{studentid}, #{attenddate}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createtime}, #{teacherid}, #{sessionId})

INSERT INTO student_attendance (courseid, classid, studentid, attenddate, status, remark, createtime, teacherid, session_id) VALUES
(#{item.courseid}, #{item.classid}, #{item.studentid}, #{item.attenddate}, #{item.status}, #{item.remark}, #{item.createtime}, #{item.teacherid}, #{item.sessionId})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = VALUES(status), remark = VALUES(remark), createtime = VALUES(createtime), session_id = VALUES(session_id)
